units.rawText: I understand your concern. Most agents were not originally soldiers and cannot withstand training that's too demanding. However, Magrasea is a battlefield, and I am responsible for their survival.

units.rawText: Alright, perhaps I'm being too hard on them. This is the only compromise I will make. Training cannot be any less rigorous than this.
